statements: Future init is explicit, offline and idempotent: resolve HOME; create/read stable identity; resolve/persist state_root; create/verify required layout directories; create/validate versioned settings and metadata; verify local writability/containment; report installation state. Rerun preserves ID/settings/state placement and fails closed on incompatible metadata unless migration is separately authorized. Empty directories do not authorize business/governed records. init cannot acquire data, update/build/qualify/activate SM, restore/migrate, mutate Watchlists, create Result/Audit, authorize execution or repair unrelated state. doctor remains read-only with no implicit init/write probe. No init is implemented.
